column3: “seventy” follows the Hebrew; the Greek and a Dead Sea Scroll read “seventy-five.”
“join themselves to” renders “be added to,” and “depart from the land” renders “go up from the land” (end of the verse).
“they were in dread of” renders “they felt a loathing (dread) of.”
“the birthstool” renders “the two stones,” an uncertain term.
“He established households for them” renders “He made houses for them.”
